`class NodeEvent<N extends Node>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Event`](/reference/events/event/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`NodeAnimateEvent`](/reference/events/nodeanimateevent/), [`NodeChangeEvent`](/reference/events/nodechangeevent/), [`NodeChildEvent`](/reference/events/nodechildevent/), [`NodeDragEvent`](/reference/events/nodedragevent/), [`NodeDrawEvent`](/reference/events/nodedrawevent/), [`NodeFieldChangeEvent`](/reference/events/nodefieldchangeevent/), [`NodeHoverEvent`](/reference/events/nodehoverevent/), [`NodeInputEvent`](/reference/events/nodeinputevent/), [`NodeProgressEvent`](/reference/events/nodeprogressevent/), [`NodeReorderEvent`](/reference/events/nodereorderevent/), [`NodeScrollEvent`](/reference/events/nodescrollevent/), [`NodeWatchEvent`](/reference/events/nodewatchevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/NodeEvent.java)

An event about a node, and the event of the node events that carry nothing else, such as `onInit` or `onDetach`.

## Description

[`Node.onInit`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onInit), [`Node.onUpdate`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onUpdate), [`Node.onMount`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onMount), [`Node.onDetach`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onDetach), the playback events of [`ResourcePlayerNode`](/reference/nodes/resourceplayernode/) and [`LineFieldNode.onSubmit`](/reference/controls/linefieldnode/#LineFieldNode-event-onSubmit) receive a plain `NodeEvent`; the other node events extend it.
